```{r}
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.  Packages
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(fixest)
library(lme4)
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)
library(purrr)
library(glmmTMB)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1.  Load & prep data (scale CF, build poly on CF_z)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- fread("Run1_Indiv_Data_for_logistic_regression.csv") %>%
  mutate(agent_key = paste0(`Run Number`, "_", name),
         id        = as.integer(factor(agent_key))) %>%
  rename(time                = `Time Step`,
         StayHome            = Response,
         SlightCough         = slight_cough,
         FeverCough          = cough_and_fever,
         CF_orig             = `Daily New Cases Day 4`,
         extraversion        = Extraversion,
         agreeableness       = Agreeableness,
         conscientiousness   = Conscientiousness,
         emotional_stability = `Emotional Stability`,
         intellect           = `Openness to Experience`) %>%
  mutate(
    CF_z  = as.numeric(scale(CF_orig)),
    age_z = as.numeric(scale(age))
  )

# build a single orthogonal basis for CF_z
polyCF <- poly(df$CF_z, 2)    # 2 columns: linear, quadratic, uncorrelated
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    CF1 = polyCF[,1],         # linear
    CF2 = polyCF[,2]          # quadratic
  )

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2.  Fit the four models
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FE1 <- feglm(StayHome ~ SlightCough + FeverCough       | id, df, family="logit")
FE2 <- feglm(StayHome ~ SlightCough + FeverCough + CF1 | id, df, family="logit")
FE3 <- feglm(StayHome ~ SlightCough + FeverCough + CF1 + CF2 | id, df, family="logit")

RE4 <- glmer(
  StayHome ~ SlightCough + FeverCough + CF1 + CF2 +
             agreeableness + conscientiousness +
             extraversion  + emotional_stability +
             intellect     + age_z + gender +
           (1|id),
  df, family=binomial,
  control = glmmTMBControl(
    optimizer = optim,
    optArgs   = list(iter.max = 1e6, eval.max = 1e6)

  )
)

models <- list(FE1=FE1, FE2=FE2, FE3=FE3, RE4=RE4)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3.  Check singularity of RE4
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
message("RE4 singular? ", lme4::isSingular(RE4, tol=1e-4))

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4.  Coefs & SEs
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
coef_table <- map_df(names(models), function(nm) {
  m <- models[[nm]]
  td <- if (inherits(m, "fixest")) broom::tidy(m) else broom.mixed::tidy(m, effects="fixed")
  td %>%
    select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) %>%
    mutate(model=nm)
})

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5.  Model‐level stats
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
get_pR2 <- function(m) if (inherits(m,"fixest")) as.numeric(r2(m,type="pr2")) else NA_real_
model_stats <- map_df(names(models), function(nm) {
  m <- models[[nm]]
  data.frame(
    model    = nm,
    N        = nobs(m),
    BIC      = BIC(m),
    PseudoR2 = get_pR2(m),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>%
  distinct(model, .keep_all=TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    N        = format(N, big.mark=","),
    BIC      = sprintf("%.1f", BIC),
    PseudoR2 = ifelse(is.na(PseudoR2),"",sprintf("%.3f",PseudoR2))
  ) %>%
  select(model,N,BIC,PseudoR2)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6.  Inspect & save
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(coef_table)
print(model_stats)

write.csv(coef_table,  "v6_model_coefficients.csv", row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(model_stats, "v6_model_gof_stats.csv",    row.names=FALSE)
```
